subject: delta(client): WF move the record anchor past the merged README and wallet session choices
note: The merged README differs from both parents of the merge, so the anchor moves to the commit that chose it, whose one parent already holds the anchored copy; the anchored manifest moves to this side's copy, which that commit holds. This commit changes only the anchor and the pins; this checkpoint states the README blob it left unchanged, so the anchored README keeps a record after the anchor.
